GET /v1/orders

Returns the authenticated workspace's orders, newest first. Last updated 11 March 2026.

Parameter Type Required Description
limit integer no Page size, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.
cursor string no Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.
status string no Filter to one of pending, dispatched or cancelled.
since string no RFC 3339 timestamp; excludes orders created before it. 
curl https://api.northgate.example/v1/orders?limit=25 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $NORTHGATE_TOKEN"
Status Meaning
200 Orders returned, with a cursor when more remain.
401 The token is missing, expired or revoked.
422 A parameter failed validation; the body names the field.
429 Rate limit exceeded; retry after the interval in the header.
